ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to online MCS-DS students. Additional ID Verification Coursera and ProctorU fees may apply. For more details on this course section, please see http://engineering.illinois.edu/online/courses/. Non-Degree seeking students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent. To request enrollment, please complete the “Non-Degree Enrollment Request Form” here: https://illinois.edu/fb/sec/9478165 TOPIC: Advanced Bayesian Modeling Description: This class meets with CS 598 section DSO (CRN 65866). Practical methods and models for Bayesian data analysis. Topics include Bayesian fundamentals, prior selection, posterior inference tools, hierarchical models, methods of Bayesian computation, model evaluation, and ordinary and generalized regression models. Emphasis on computational implementation. Prerequisites: STAT 420 and knowledge of R.
